name: A Whore New Ball Game
source:
A Whore New Ball Game is a netorase visual novel about prostitution played from either just the husband's or both the husband's and wife's perspective.

You own an electronics store with your wife, but competition from the bigger chain store nearby and the internet are hurting your business so much a visit from a customer has become a rarity. A visit from a rich customer ends up giving you the idea to make some money to pay off your debt: invite people over to have sex with your wife for money.

[From [url=https://infidelisoft.itch.io/a-whore-new-ball-game-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《妓女新球赛》是一部关于卖淫的网络视觉小说，从丈夫或丈夫和妻子的角度进行游戏。

你和妻子拥有一家电子产品商店，但来自附近较大连锁店和互联网的竞争对你的业务造成了严重损害，以至于很少有顾客光顾。一位富有的顾客来访，最终让你产生了赚钱还债的想法：为了钱邀请人们来和你的妻子发生性关系。

[来自[url=https://infidelisoft.itch.io/a-whore-new-ball-game-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
